name: ordessa-mcp-pi-bridge
description: Ordessa managed-lane Pi bridge extension (Q4 T10). Loaded by Pi via jiti exactly like the acp-adapter permission gate (-e <path>); no compilation step. Registers only Server-validated tool bridges over the loopback control channel implemented by backend/managed/pi_bridge.py; never connects to an MCP server and never holds a secretRef. Executable code: version/license/trust registration live in the manifest emitted by scripts/pack.mjs.

piManifest.controlChannel: 127.0.0.1 (host literal in source; port+token come from ORDESSA_PI_BRIDGE_* env set by the Ordessa Server launcher)
